data.headline: Engineering Leader |  Product Development | Driving Innovation in Automotive Industry
data.about:
As a dynamic and results-oriented Engineering leader, I excel in driving quality, revenue growth, and operational efficiency through strategic leadership and innovative solutions. With a keen focus on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies, I have a track record of optimizing processes and enhancing product quality. I am committed to leading high-performing teams to deliver exceptional results and drive organizational success in dynamic and competitive markets.

I bring extensive expertise across various domains, encompassing web and mobile applications, cloud infrastructure, eCommerce, B2C and B2B marketplace platforms, systems integration, predictive modeling, last mile delivery and payment processing. This diverse experience extends across both startups and enterprise companies in industries such as Real Estate, Construction, Auto Tech, and Education.

experiences.title: Director, Head of Engineering - RepairPal (A Yelp Company)
experiences.subtitle: Yelp . undefined
experiences.caption: Dec 2024 - Present · 1 yr 1 mo

description.text:
RepairPal (acquired by Yelp in 2024) is a leading online marketplace connecting consumers with trusted auto repair shops. Our platform serves as a comprehensive resource, offering repair cost estimates tailored to brand, model, year, location, and type of repair. Consumers can also explore common car issues, review frequently asked questions, and access valuable insights to make informed decisions.

With millions of monthly visitors, RepairPal empowers users by providing reliable information and connecting them to trusted repair professionals. At its core, RepairPal operates as a three-way marketplace platform, powered by proprietary software and supported by cutting-edge open-source technology. This robust combination enables us to deliver a seamless experience for consumers, repair shops, and partners alike.

At Plantt (acquired by Monrovia in 2020) we built the ultimate online lawn and garden marketplace by providing garden centers with a turnkey e-commerce solution and consumers with online inspiration and resources. As a founding engineer, I got a unique opportunity to architect and bring nation-wide garden center chain stores on marketplace in matter of months. The platform was later acquired by Monrovia, a largest wholesale nursery supplier & plant grower.
• Contribute to overall business & technology strategy along with the founders
• Present to due diligence committee during funding rounds
• Joined Founder Friendly Labs (FFL) startup accelerator for mentorship, networking and to scale MVP product
• Actively involved in platform architecture, product planning, building the engineering team, putting in place the best industry software development practices, culture and ensuring execution
• Hands-on working with engineering team to build web services, data models and CI/CD on AWS & Azure
• Work with distributed team of engineers in US & South Americas

experiences.title: ZapLabs, Formerly Zip Realty (Innovation hub for Realogy)
experiences.subtitle: undefined · 7 yrs

description.text:
ZipRealty (acquired in 2014 by Realogy and renamed to ZapLabs) is a Innovation hub for Realogy.

• Building new processes and pipelines to ensure delivery of high quality, enterprise-ready features and products by leveraging unit testing, automation and continuous delivery, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement
• Recruit and coach top technical talent – growing team from 5 engineers to 70 onsite and 40 offsite
• Led teams to build reusable patterns and reference architectures across 15 cross functional pods
• Increased throughput by 25%, increased flow efficiency by 35%, reduced cherry picks and hotfixes by 50%
• Led teams to decompose the Monolith with Domain Driven Design and substantially reducing the release time
• Contribute to overall business strategy with senior leadership team
• Work collaboratively across team boundaries to share common infrastructure and functional capabilities
• Partnered with HRBP to develop an extensive career matrix for Individual Contribution and Management tracks for technology group
• Developed technology roadmap and partnered with SLT & product leads to align with product roadmap
• Led teams for iPhone & Android mobile app development
• Committee member for GDPR & SOCII

Realogy is a global leader in real estate franchising with company-owned real estate brokerage operations doing business under its franchise systems. Realogy's brands and business units include Better Homes and Gardens® Real Estate, CENTURY 21®, Coldwell Banker®, Coldwell Banker Commercial®, The Corcoran Group®, ERA®, Sotheby's International Realty®, ZipRealty®, NRT LLC, Cartus and Title Resource Group.

• Hiring, building and mentoring all-star Engineer teams
• Develop competitive differentiation by ensuring team has best-in-class technical talent to innovate and solve challenging problems
• Lead and direct architectures sufficiently flexible and adaptable to meet market emerging requirements
• Become and stay an expert in current and emerging technologies, trends and practices
• Represent engineering team in product development requirements and creation of schedules and budgets
• Collaborating with senior leaders in the organization to strategies around technical direction
• Lead engineering teams to build, scale and rapid roll-out of the platform to brokers

ZipRealty, Inc. is a U.S. real estate company with over 2500 licensed agents. The company operates in 35 major markets in 22 states and the District of Columbia. The company provides home sellers and buyers with an innovative real estate solution by streamlining the real estate process and is able to pass significant savings on to the clients.

• Responsible for CRM application used by third party brokerages and real estate agents of ZipRealty.
• Lead the design and development of the next version of enterprise CRM web and mobile apps.
• Implemented Cloud Communication using Twilio (buy phone number, forwarding, SMS, recording, etc.) 
• Implemented integration with leads platforms Zillow, Trulia and Lear Router.
• Implemented integration with social media platforms – LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook and Lithium Community.
• Enhanced Integration to Active Directory using Atlassian Crowd & Confluence to CRM.
• Development of scoring algorithm based on the user activity to assign leads to the agent.
• Coordinate and implement deployment schedule, integration approach, resource allocations and time budgets. 
• Work with other departments (finance, marketing, brokerage) on cross-departmental projects.

Technologies: Java, Spring, JSP, JS/Ajax/YUI, hibernate, Oracle 11, SVN, Maven

DBO2 (acquired in 2007 by Industrial Scientific and renamed to Predictive Solutions in 2010) is a leader in monitoring safety processes in the workplace. DBO2’s leading product, SafetyNet, is a hosted (SaaS) solution for collecting safety inspections and using advanced analytics to predict and prevent worker injuries, while improving quality and productivity.

• Lead a team on four projects – Integration with Amazon S3 Cloud Service, Data Warehouse/Analytics, Apache Servicemix ESB for Scantron machines and Migration to Oracle & Linux platform
• Manage team of 5 developers in Redwood City, 3 QA specialists in Vietnam. Also oversee outsourced development of iPhone application by team in Pittsburg, PA and support team in India.
• Responsible for all Enterprise Software developed by Predictive Solutions, both internal and customer-facing.
• Ensure that all enterprise software is High quality, delivered according to schedule and delivered within budget.
• Leverage AI to improve the business.
• Gain efficiencies through automation.
• Continually research new technology and industry best-practices and incorporate them into development practices.

Technologies: Java, JME, Struts, Spring, JSP, JS/Ajax/YUI, REST, iBATIS, SQL (SQLServer 2005), Oracle 11, MDX, JUnit, Ant, SVN, Maven

As one of the first engineers and a core member of the development team involved in concept, design, architecture decisions and development of all product offerings. This includes:
• "SafetyNet" - Multi-tenancy web-application (SAAS).
• "DBO2Mobile" - Standalone application that runs on Windows mobile platform and exchanges data with the web-application.
• "DBO2BlackBerry" - Standalone application that runs on Blackberry devices and exchanges data with the web-application.
• "DataNet" - Integration Framework to enable data flow from various systems into SafetyNet.
• Running numerous models in Cubist, CART, See5, TreeNet and Random Forest for predicting lost time and worker injuries.
• Lead a team to build the predictive model in production. This turned out to be a high value feature that enabled to be acquired by
Industrial Scientific in 2007.
• Introduced Spring and AJAX driven features using Yahoo User Interface into the application technology stack.
• Improved development process by contributing to Agile software development process with Scrum.

Technologies: Java, JME, Struts, Spring, JSP, JS/Ajax/YUI, REST, iBATIS, SQL (SQLServer), MDX, JUnit, Ant, SVN, Maven, Cubist
